_nota: RAG evaluation questions (F12.5). Each question is anchored in a text that exists in the NASA PDFs: the anchors were looked up directly in the extracted text, without going through the search, and all 16 were confirmed to exist (14 Nov 2026). It hits if the expected text appears in the excerpt of any of the first 3 passages, in any document: the Technical Briefs cite the same requirements as the standard. The last two questions have no answer in the sources and must be left without a passage.
